bestiary.locations: Plains of Havoc, Mount Sternum, Femor Hills, Cyclops Camp, Cyclopolis, Ancient Temple, Shadowthorn, Orc Fort, Mistrock, Foreigner Quarter, Outlaw Camp and the Cyclops version of the Forsaken Mine.
bestiary.notes: One-eyed cyclopes search for metals in their caves and defend their territory fiercely. They are strong, skilled at metalwork and will move obstacles or weaker creatures to reach an intruder.
